novel_features.name: Today briefing
novel_features.description: One snapshot of your streak, reading time, friends thinking now, unread counts and pending requests.
novel_features.rationale: Live join across endpoints the web app spreads over several screens.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this first when an agent needs a morning status of the user's Philonet reading habit.

novel_features.name: Reading rhythm
novel_features.description: Weekly and monthly reading minutes, longest streak and rank-vs-friends trend, accumulated from your own runs (history starts at the first run).
novel_features.rationale: History exists only in local snapshots; the web app shows just today.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for recap or goal questions over time, not live status.

novel_features.name: Friends digest
novel_features.description: Friends' thoughts this CLI first saw recently, grouped by friend; 'recently' is relative to when the CLI saw them.
novel_features.rationale: Joins stored feed cards (topped up from your friends and For You feeds on every run) with your friends list, grouped per friend and time-windowed.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catch up on friends' takes without scrolling the feed.

novel_features.name: Owed replies
novel_features.description: Threads among your recent thoughts where someone replied and you have not answered yet.
novel_features.rationale: Live join of your recent thoughts, their reply threads and the discussions inbox to find threads awaiting your answer.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to find conversations waiting on the user.

novel_features.name: Voices
novel_features.description: Rank people from your stored For You feed cards by thoughts on a topic, filtered by alma mater or employer badge.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates starter profiles and verification badges across stored feed cards (topped up from your For You feed on every run) with tag and topic filters.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find credentialed voices on a topic when the web search cannot filter by badge.

novel_features.name: Reading queue
novel_features.description: Read-later and bookmarks that fit your free minutes (items with unknown length are dropped unless --include-unknown), flagged when discussed.
novel_features.rationale: Joins saved items with reading time and thought counts.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick what to read next given available time.

novel_features.name: Resonance
novel_features.description: Which of your thoughts earned stars and insightful reactions, by tag and week.
novel_features.rationale: Joins your thoughts with the awards you received to rank what landed.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tell the user what kind of thoughts land with people.

narrative.headline: Your Philonet reading life in the terminal: feed, threads, streaks and friends, plus a local history the web app does not keep.
narrative.value_prop: Philonet has no public API, so this CLI replays the web app's own backend calls with your token. Run today for a morning snapshot, rhythm to build up reading history, and digest or owed to catch up on friends and unanswered replies. It can also post, react, send friend requests and invite people; every write supports --dry-run.
narrative.auth_narrative: Philonet uses a bearer JWT held in your browser. Copy the accessToken from philonet.ai (DevTools > Application > Local Storage) and run 'philonet-pp-cli auth set-token' (or export PHILONET_TOKEN); 'auth status' shows what is configured and 'auth logout' clears it. The token lasts about six months. Philonet is an unofficial client of an undocumented API and can change without notice.

quickstart.comment: Verify-safe health check without a network call
See your streak, unread counts and friends reading now
Browse the For You feed compactly
Start recording reading history; it grows with every run

troubleshoots.fix: Your token expired; copy a fresh accessToken from philonet.ai local storage and run philonet-pp-cli auth set-token
digest only lists friends' thoughts first seen within --since; widen --since, add --all, or raise --max-scan-pages
voices ranks cards stored from your For You feed; loosen --topic or --badge, or raise --max-scan-pages
Philonet reports only the last week, so history starts at your first rhythm run; run it regularly

narrative.when_to_use: Use for reading or checking a user's Philonet feed, search, threads, stats, friends and notifications, for local analysis of data this CLI has stored, and for explicitly requested actions: posting a thought or reply, reacting, sending a friend request or inviting someone. Write commands act on the user's real account, so run them with --dry-run first and send only after the user confirms. Good for morning briefings and weekly recaps.
anti_triggers: Posting, replying, reacting, friend-requesting or inviting unless the user explicitly asked for that exact action
Anything needing an official, stable API; this is an unofficial client of an undocumented backend
